items.title: Extension by zero reflects exactness of complexes of modules on an open of a ringed site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a complex of modules on an object U of a ringed site is exact exactly when its extension by zero along j_U is exact as a sequence of modules on the site. Since j_{U!} is already known to be exact, it suffices to prove that it reflects injections and surjections. This is done through the adjunction unit G -> j_U^*j_{U!}G: the unit is shown to be an injection by unwinding the construction of extension by zero as the sheafification of a sectionwise injective rule, and the reflection of surjections is obtained from the same unit together with exactness of j_U^* (proof lines 2419-2458). H2: the explicit description of the adjunction unit and its use to reflect both injections and surjections is the substance.
